Notable Incidents Summary (Jun 22-23, 2026)

  • Attempted break-in/vandalism at Nordstrom Rack (EPAPD, 5:00 AM Jun 23): Male subject in green/yellow hat and black hoodie threw rock at front glass entry, causing breakage. Security footage captured on video. Store cleared—no evidence of successful entry. East Palo Alto.
  • Reckless vehicle activity (EPAPD, 3:59–4:40 AM Jun 23): Two vehicles (silver BMW, black Nissan) engaged in high-speed driving, running stop signs, nearly hitting pedestrians. Third vehicle (dark pickup truck, possibly Ford F-150 with camper) also involved. Silver BMW recovered unoccupied at Palo Verde & Oakwood with windows down. Registered owner has extensive history including noise complaints and theft reports. Possible coordinated activity or crime spree.
  • Knife incident at Gateway Apartments (MPPD, 8:38 PM Jun 22): Verbal 415 escalated when one party drew a knife on another over parking spot dispute. WFA with brown hair armed with knife. Less-lethal deployment authorized. Both parties separated.
  • Attempted robbery/strong-arm robbery arrest (EPAPD, 3:26–3:50 PM Jun 22): Female subject detained on 211 (robbery) and 148 (PC) charges coordinated with Mountain View PD. Mountain View case #2890.
  • Sexual abuse investigation ongoing (EPAPD, 10:40 AM & 10:48 PM Jun 22): Multiple agencies (CPS, River City PD) coordinating regarding possible sexual abuse involving juvenile at 2 Newell Court, Apt. 2108. Extended agency involvement suggests potential felony.
  • Unconfirmed man with axe report (EPAPD, 7:26 PM Jun 22): 7-Eleven at 77 Newell—security reported subject with axe. Staff/RP saw no one. No description, no follow-up confirmation.
  • Aggressive subject with object in hand (EPAPD, 5:46 PM Jun 22): BMA 40s wearing Spider-Man mask at Country Time Market, aggressive behavior, attempted to fight RP, item in hand (unidentified). RP declined to press charges.
  • Church vandalism (MPPD, 12:48 PM Jun 22): Damage to doors at church (201 Ravens), monitor smashed. Broken glass on south side between school and church. No recent graffiti history on file.
  • Walgreens theft (MPPD, 4:24 PM Jun 22): Three individuals in hooded sweatshirts fled back of store with items. Theft of candy (~$300 value). Store declined prosecution; subjects advised of trespassing violations.

Note: Most incidents are in East Palo Alto and Atherton; few directly on Berkeley Ave or Coleman Ave in Menlo Oaks. Reckless driving incident and attempted robbery warrant monitoring for pattern.
